inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The manuscript names the closest comparator frameworks, states the shared producer-checker features and the P33-specific owner semantics, and bounds every originality statement to documented support.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript contains a closest-work comparison that names the closest comparator frameworks, identifies the producer-checker features shared with them, distinguishes the P33-specific mathematical owner semantics, and expressly limits every originality statement to support documented by that comparison.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A substantive closest-work comparison addresses at least one required element, but one or more of the following remains missing or incomplete: named closest comparators, the shared producer-checker features, the P33-specific owner semantics, or an explicit documented-support bound on every originality statement.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the Round-1 baseline, the manuscript removes or weakens the limitation on originality or priority, broadens an originality statement beyond documented support, or further blurs rather than distinguishes shared producer-checker features and P33-specific owner semantics.

operationalization.fully_addressed: A manuscript-facing artifact manifest covers every artifact named in the reproducibility claim, and each artifact entry supplies either a resolvable locator, exact path, version, SHA-256 value, and access condition, or an explicit unavailable designation whose surrounding prose does not imply that the artifact is retrievable.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A real artifact manifest or unavailability disclosure is added, but at least one named artifact is omitted, at least one available artifact lacks one or more of locator, exact path, version, SHA-256, or access condition, or an unavailable artifact is still described in a way that implies retrievability.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the Round-1 baseline, the manuscript strengthens a retrievability or reproducibility claim while the required artifact fields remain absent, removes an existing hash or availability limitation, or newly implies access to an artifact that is designated or shown as unavailable.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript identifies a frozen fixture set with independently authored expected outcomes and recorded oracle provenance; presents a trust graph that explicitly includes producers, adapters, checker kernels, libraries, theorem encodings, fixture-oracle authorship, and accountable implementers; classifies every shared dependency as allowed, disclosed, or disqualifying; states that verifier predicate kernels contain no producer decision code; and records build/provenance hashes for the producer, adapter, and checker components.
operationalization.partially_addressed: Substantive fixture, trust-graph, dependency-classification, code-separation, or build-provenance evidence is supplied, but one or more required actor or dependency categories is absent, expected-outcome independence or oracle provenance is incomplete, a shared dependency remains unclassified, producer decision-code exclusion is not established, or one or more required component hashes is missing.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the Round-1 baseline, the manuscript strengthens an independence claim while hiding or collapsing shared dependencies or accountable authorship, newly permits producer decision code in verifier predicate kernels, or removes fixture-oracle provenance, dependency classifications, or producer/adapter/checker build hashes.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The schema surface gives an exact canonical-byte rule and closed enum definitions, enumerates the proof-type registry and allowed state transitions, defines the digest domain and validator predicates, and supplies concrete fixture bytes that exercise at least one valid record and at least one invalid record.
operationalization.partially_addressed: A genuine byte-level or testable schema specification is present, but at least one of canonical bytes, closed enums, proof-type registry, state transitions, digest domain, validator predicates, valid fixture bytes, or invalid fixture bytes remains unspecified or non-executable.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the Round-1 baseline, the schema becomes more open-ended or nondeterministic, an exact byte, enum, registry, transition, digest, predicate, or fixture requirement is removed, or prose newly claims a frozen or testable contract without the corresponding definitions and both valid and invalid fixture bytes.
